title: Helicopter with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Main rotor blur -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='14' rx='38' ry='4' fill='#7FD8FF' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Main rotor mast -->
  <rect x='47' y='12' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#C0C8D0'/>
  <!-- Main rotor blades -->
  <rect x='12' y='11' width='76' height='4' rx='2' fill='#A0B0C0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='13' r='3' fill='#D8E8F0'/>
  <!-- Tail boom -->
  <rect x='62' y='40' width='28' height='7' rx='3' fill='#FFCB3D'/>
  <!-- Tail rotor -->
  <circle cx='90' cy='43' r='9' fill='#FFE68A' opacity='0.6'/>
  <rect x='88' y='34' width='3' height='18' rx='1.5' fill='#FFB020'/>
  <rect x='81' y='42' width='18' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FFB020'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='43' r='3' fill='#FFF0C0'/>
  <!-- Tail fin -->
  <path d='M85 34 L92 30 L92 50 L85 50 Z' fill='#FF8C42'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='48' rx='32' ry='22' fill='#FFCB3D'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='56' rx='24' ry='12' fill='#FFE68A'/>
  <!-- Cockpit window -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='42' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#7FD8FF'/>
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='40' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#C0F0FF' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Landing skids -->
  <rect x='20' y='70' width='44' height='4' rx='2' fill='#A0B0C0'/>
  <rect x='24' y='64' width='4' height='8' rx='1' fill='#C0C8D0'/>
  <rect x='56' y='64' width='4' height='8' rx='1' fill='#C0C8D0'/>
  <!-- Smiling face on body -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='46' r='3' fill='#2A6E8A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='3' fill='#2A6E8A'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='45' r='1' fill='#D0F0FF'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='45' r='1' fill='#D0F0FF'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M36 52 Q43 60 50 52' stroke='#2A6E8A' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='52' r='3' fill='#FF8C8C' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='52' r='3' fill='#FF8C8C' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
